name: Filtron Engineers Limited
about: Filtron Engineers Limited engages in the manufacture and supply of dairy, food, beverages, and chemical equipment in India. The company provides dairy equipment for dairy farm systems, milk transportation and reception, liquid milk processing, milk storage, concentration and drying, milk handling plants, and milk product manufacture. It also offers process equipment, such as flow equipment, compact heat exchangers, centrifuges, evaporators and dryers, and homogenizers and mixers; and vegetables processing equipment for vegetable washing, cleaning, sorting, dicing, shredding, heat treatment, and shrink/pouch packaging, as well as beverage processing equipment. Filtron Engineers Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Pune, India.
